versions.subject: Merge PR #4961 from @tsale - Add multiples rules and updates
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\fodhelper.exe'
    Image|endswith:
        - '\rundll32.exe'
        - '\regsvr32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'odbcconf.exe'
        - 'regsvr'
        - 'shellexec_rundll'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'installdriver'
        - 'setfiledsndir'
        - 'vkipdse'
    CommandLine|endswith|windash:
        - '/a'
        - '/f'
        - '/s'
condition: selection
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\fodhelper.exe" Image IN ("*\\rundll32.exe", "*\\regsvr32.exe") CommandLine="*odbcconf.exe*" CommandLine="*regsvr*" CommandLine="*shellexec_rundll*" CommandLine IN ("*installdriver*", "*setfiledsndir*", "*vkipdse*") CommandLine="*-a" OR CommandLine="*/a" OR CommandLine="*–a" OR CommandLine="*—a" OR CommandLine="*―a" OR CommandLine="*-f" OR CommandLine="*/f" OR CommandLine="*–f" OR CommandLine="*—f" OR CommandLine="*―f" OR CommandLine="*-s" OR CommandLine="*/s" OR CommandLine="*–s" OR CommandLine="*—s" OR CommandLine="*―s"
